page.overview:
Who is Angel Wings?

Angel Wings is a female Pegasus pony who appears in the season six episode Top Bolt as one of the Wonderbolt Academy trainees. She has a grayish cream coat, a light brown mane with bright red streaks, blue eyes, and a cutie mark of a winged heart, and she wears a bright red bow in her mane and two red bracelets on her left foreleg.

Angel Wings is an original character created by Lex Heule. Heule has a congenital heart disease and connective tissue disorder, and they were able to play their own character in the show through the Make-A-Wish Foundation, making them the second individual to do so after Sylvain-Nicholas LeVasseur-Portelance, who voiced Stellar Eclipse.

Angel Wings is the eleventh original character to appear in the show, preceded by Holly Dash, SM, Peachy Pitt, Wild Fire, Midnight Strike, "Slendermane", Stellar Eclipse, "Whoa Nelly", and Bittersweet and Leadwing. She was designed through GeneralZoi's Pony Creator and referred to by Heule as "Angel Heart" in November 2015. In her initial design, she had a gray muzzle and white bow.

According to Heule (prior to the show ending), Angel Wings may reappear "in the background of other episodes in the future"; Heule "prerecorded some extra noises and stuff to be in the background later".
